placements.policy: Nearest orthogonal analysis frame within rounding_limit; source translations and handedness preserved

warnings.message: Rounded near-rigid placements normalized for analysis only; inspect placement diagnostics.

axles.selection: Catalog descriptions beginning Technic Axle followed by a numeric length; excludes axle pins, joiners and axle-hole supports

coverage: pyldraw3 contacts for selected library parts only; no rigid grouping, collision proof or general mobility inference
selection: non-embedded library parts with |x|>=45, -300<=y<=10 and z in [-400,-200] or [180,380] (full-model frame): the four suspension corners and their frame mounts
